walkthroughs.body_html: UK 2021: Bangladeshi, Pakistani and Black African groups have higher poverty rates than White British. Macpherson Report (1999) defined institutional racism after Stephen Lawrence murder. Modood (2007): ethnic minority experience varies — Indians and Chinese outperform Whites in education.

Pilcher (1995): age status is socially constructed and varies. UK Equality Act 2010 makes age a protected characteristic. Children and older adults face economic dependency. Townsend (1981): structured dependency theory — older people impoverished by retirement and pensions.

Crenshaw (1989) showed black women's discrimination at work was invisible to legal frameworks treating race and gender separately. Hill Collins (2000): 'matrix of domination' interweaves race, class, gender, sexuality. Modern sociology rarely analyses one axis alone.

options: Ethnocentrism is the same as racism.

Judging other cultures by the standards of one's own — assuming one's own cultural practices and values are normal or superior. It is a methodological problem in social research as well as a social phenomenon.
Ethnocentrism means concentrating on your own ethnic group only.
